answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 7870 Country: India Title: In the light of Ahadis and Holy Quran please guide me whether can i wear an orange suit as it is the colour mostly used and treated hol by hindus.kindly do reply as i am planning to buy one for Eid. Question: Asslamu Aalaikum, In the light of Ahadis and Holy Quran please guide me whether can i wear an orange suit as it is the colour mostly used and treated hol by hindus.kindly do reply as i am planning to buy one for Eid. Answer ID: 7870 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1009/1009=M/1429) You can wear orange colour suit: کرہ لبس المعصفر والمزعفر الاحمر والاصفر للرجال، مفادہ ان لا یکرہ للنساء Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
